flaw_addressed_description: The authors addressed the limited evaluation scope by adding a dedicated sentiment control task in Appendix F and including results for the GPT-2 model family in Appendix I.1. Although the references to these appendices were present in the submitted paper, the flaw description states that the actual content was added/improved in the camera-ready version, thus broadening the empirical coverage.

The authors addressed the limitations in the toxicity reduction evaluation by adding a GPT-4-based preference analysis as a surrogate for human evaluation (referenced in eftable:toxicity_gpt4) and by extending the investigation of parameters for existing baselines to ensure fairer comparisons. These changes, as noted in the flaw description, rectify the initially flawed and limited evaluation setup.

While the perplexity graphs for fluency validation were reportedly added to Appendix I.2 (as indicated by the flaw description), the camera-ready paper does not include any visible clarification in the main body of the 'Fine-grained Control' section regarding the empirical approach to selecting lambda coefficients, nor does it provide explicit principled guidance for these parameters. Therefore, this significant part of the flaw remains unaddressed in the visible text.
